$comment: K-2301 process centrifugal compressor twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the compressor map, the gas data and the protection settings; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.manufacturer: Siemens Energy (compressor family); map of this twin assumed
identification.model: Single-shaft centrifugal compressor, vertically split (barrel) casing, API 617
identification.description: Process gas compressor of a refinery unit, one section, six impellers, motor + VSD + gearbox
identification.casing: Vertically split (barrel) casing, one section, 6 closed impellers, balance piston
identification.driver: Induction motor with variable speed drive and speed-increasing gearbox
identification.seals: Tandem dry gas seals at both ends (for example John Crane Type 28XP), nitrogen separation seals
identification.bearings: Tilting-pad journal bearings (drive end, non-drive end) and double-acting tilting-pad thrust bearing
identification.protection: API 670 machinery protection system: X/Y proximity probes at each journal bearing, two axial position probes, bearing RTDs
identification.anti_surge: Anti-surge controller with recycle valve from discharge (after the cooler) back to suction

gas.source: Light hydrocarbon process gas: molar mass, ratio of specific heats cp/cv and average compressibility over the compression, from the process data sheet. assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine (use the gas analysis and an equation of state).

map.source: Compressor performance map at rated speed (actual inlet flow, polytropic head, polytropic efficiency), as on the vendor's predicted performance curves, fitted as head = H0 (c0 + c1 x + c2 x^2) and efficiency = eta0 (1 - curv (x - 1)^2) with x = Q / (Q0 N/N0); surge at x = 0.70, stonewall at x = 1.25. assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine. The envelope (flow, speed, impellers) is inside the Siemens Energy barrel compressor range.

process.source: Normal operating point from the process data sheet: suction drum pressure and temperature, discharge header pressure, normal actual inlet flow. assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine

flow_element.source: Suction flow element (venturi or orifice) constant: Q = C sqrt(dp / rho), from the flow element sizing sheet (gives 250 mbar at rated flow). assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine

anti_surge.source: Surge control line 10 % of flow to the right of the surge line (published practice: 3 to 10 %); recycle valve sized for 2.0 times the surge flow at rated speed (published practice: 1.8 to 2.2 times). Pipeline & Gas Journal, March 2012. Values for this machine: assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine

drive.source: Gas power / shaft power at the motor: bearing, seal and gearbox losses. assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine

seals.source: Tandem dry gas seal; Type 28XP limits 180 bar and 200 m/s from the John Crane product page. Normal primary vent flow and seal gas differential pressure over the reference (balance line) pressure: assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine (use the seal vendor's leakage data and the seal support system data sheet).

bearings.source: Normal bearing metal temperatures, lube oil supply and shaft vibration (peak-to-peak) at rated speed: assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine (use the commissioning baseline of your machine).

demo.note: Demo only: the stand-in runs in real time; failure modes ramp in over about a minute so their fingerprints appear quickly.

points.label: Seal gas supply over reference pressure
Shaft vibration, drive end (larger of X and Y)
Shaft vibration, non-drive end (larger of X and Y)

limits.source: Alarm set points: assumption: typical value, replace with the values of your own machine (copy them from the anti-surge controller, the API 670 monitor and the seal panel)

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

impeller_fouling.name: Impeller and diffuser fouling
impeller_fouling.symptoms: polytropic efficiency and head below the map at the same reduced flow; speed and power up to hold the discharge pressure

surge_approach.name: Turndown towards surge (low process flow)
surge_approach.symptoms: process flow falls, the anti-surge controller holds the control line by recycling gas

asv_stuck.name: Anti-surge valve stuck closed during a turndown
asv_stuck.symptoms: controller asks the valve to open, position stays shut, surge margin collapses

seal_primary_wear.name: Dry gas seal primary ring wear (drive end)
seal_primary_wear.symptoms: primary vent flow of one seal rises, the other end unchanged

seal_gas_supply.name: Seal gas supply low (filter blocked or booster failed)
seal_gas_supply.symptoms: seal gas pressure over the reference falls: unfiltered process gas can reach the seal faces

thrust_overload.name: Thrust overload (balance piston labyrinth wear)
thrust_overload.symptoms: thrust bearing temperature up, rotor moves towards the active thrust pads

rotor_unbalance.name: Rotor unbalance (deposits shed from an impeller)
rotor_unbalance.symptoms: shaft vibration up at running speed, temperatures normal

discharge_tt_drift.name: Discharge temperature transmitter drift
discharge_tt_drift.symptoms: efficiency looks low but the motor power does not agree with the gas power
